items.title: CVNA Stock Drops Amid Worries Investor Mark Walter May Unload $2B Stake
items.summary: Walter, one of Carvana’s largest investors, holds roughly 30 million shares, or about a 4% stake worth around $2 billion, according to Bloomberg.

items.title: Carvana Stock Falls Amid Concerns About Walter Probe
items.summary: Shares of Carvana dropped 7.3% Tuesday as worries swirl that a federal investigation into one of its investors, Mark Walter, could lead to the billionaire selling his stake of the used car retailer. After falling yesterday, Carvana shares are now down about 13% this week.

items.title: 3 Big Reasons to Love Carvana (CVNA)
items.summary: Since February 2026, Carvana has been in a holding pattern, posting a small loss of 3% while floating around $70.14. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 13.1% gain during that period.

items.title: Carvana Drops 7% With Bulls, Bears Split Over the Business Model
items.summary: Carvana just posted its best quarter ever, yet the stock keeps sliding while a traditional rival is up over 50% this year. Something about that gap deserves a closer look.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Aug. 17: Markets Inch Lower and Treasury Yields Rise as Investors Wait for Retail Earnings
items.summary: On Aug. 17, 2026, bond yields climbed while major indices drifted near record levels ahead of pivotal retail earnings reports.

items.title: Carvana flourishes as used-car inventory grows
items.summary: The second quarter saw Carvana set all-time records for revenue, net income and retail units sold.

items.title: Reddit is Up 11% Premarket After S&P 500 Addition. Here’s How Other New S&P 500 Stocks Performed.
items.summary: Index funds may be forced to buy nearly three times Reddit's average daily trading volume after its S&P 500 announcement, but a look at the last twelve additions to the benchmark tells a very different story about what happens next.
